items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: Henry Allen's father. Henry Reed Allen's father.

ctx.x: Right up here. By River Road?

Yeah, somewhere up in there. Louis came in here with a I think it was a ten or eleven piece of band. Chicago, because it was most of us. We had two musicians in there from locally from here. They left and gone to New York, Chicago too. We had Preston Jackson from Moncrime. Preston, he's on the... Just made a recording with me about a year ago. Just released. Oh yeah? Less than a year ago. And they had a... Bass player Johnny Lindsey, he was from here. We had Tubby Hall, he was a drummer. He was from New Orleans.…
Was Pico still playing High Society then? Before he played all his days. That's a great song. Yeah.
